Printed edition: Alexander von Humboldt's Reise in die Aequinoktial-Gegenden des neuen Kontinents. 1, 1889, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/11630797bsb. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 83%, 64%, 81% of their four-word runs in the scan's text.
